story_info.title: Oliver Fox and the Wobbly Tower
story_info.subtitle: Building Fun with Friends
story_info.moral: Playing and helping friends makes friendships strong.

main_character.name: Oliver Fox
main_character.appearance: Oliver is a slim young fox with bright orange-red fur, a fluffy white-tipped tail, and perky triangular ears. He has clever amber eyes and a playful, confident grin.

supporting_characters.name: Pip Squirrel
supporting_characters.appearance: A tiny brown squirrel with a bushy tail and bright, curious eyes. He wears a small green scarf.
supporting_characters.role: Needs help building a tall block tower that keeps falling down.

cover.visual_action: Oliver Fox and Pip Squirrel building a tall block tower together

slides.title: A Day in Blossom Meadow
slides.text: Oliver Fox skipped to Blossom Meadow. The sun was warm and bright. He saw his friend, Pip Squirrel. Pip had many colourful blocks. He wanted to build a very tall tower. But *plink, plonk!* The tower kept falling down. Pip looked a little sad. Oliver walked closer to see.

slides.title: Pip Needs Help
slides.text: “Hello, Pip!” Oliver said with a smile. Pip looked up. “Hi, Oliver,” he chirped. “I want to build a super tall tower. But it keeps falling down!” Pip sighed. Oliver saw how much Pip wanted to play. “Maybe I can help?” Oliver asked.

slides.title: Let's Solve It Together!
slides.text: Pip brightened. “Really?” he asked. Oliver nodded his fluffy tail. “Yes! Let's solve it together!” he said. “Maybe we can make the bottom blocks wider?” Oliver showed Pip how. Pip added blocks carefully. They took turns placing each one.

slides.title: A Tall, Strong Tower
slides.text: Up, up, up the tower grew! Oliver placed a red block. Pip placed a blue block. They giggled as it got taller. They worked as a team. The tower stood strong and straight. It was almost as tall as Oliver! What a great job they were doing.

slides.title: Happy Friends
slides.text: “We did it!” Pip cheered. Oliver grinned. “We built such a big tower!” They both felt very proud. Playing together was so much fun. It made their friendship strong. They knew they could always help each other. Oliver gave Pip a happy high-five.

publishing.hook: A tower that keeps falling? Oliver Fox knows just what to do!
publishing.instagram_caption_short: Oliver Fox finds his friend Pip Squirrel feeling sad. Pip's block tower keeps falling! See how Oliver uses his clever ideas to help Pip. This story shows how much fun playing together can be. It teaches little ones about building strong friendships and working as a team. Save this story for your next reading time!
publishing.instagram_caption_long: In Blossom Meadow, Oliver Fox discovers his friend Pip Squirrel facing a challenge. Pip wants to build a super tall block tower, but it just won't stay up! Feeling a little sad, Pip isn't sure what to do. That's when Oliver steps in with his friendly grin and clever ideas. Together, they learn the joy of teamwork, taking turns, and finding creative solutions. This heartwarming story is perfect for teaching children aged 3-6 about the power of strong friendships and how much fun playing together can be. It’s a wonderful reminder that helping each other makes every adventure better. Save this story for your next reading time!
